instrumentation_note: Case-local ASM runtime probe observes bytecode guard, throw, line coverage and direct client TCP I/O; original JUnit lifecycle runner comes from the legacy GraphChecker jar, but no graph/static/aggregate/closure output controls execution.
elapsed_measurement: sum of all completed case-local JVM runs including probe preflight, healthy seed, positive control and fault trials; excludes manual source review/build time and idle gaps
stopping_reason: Runtime feedback over the healthy seed and 25 trial traces exposed 16 direct I/O (site, ordinal) occurrences before a later target guard. Fifteen were exactly faulted. The sole remainder, client TCP write ordinal 6, was observed before a later target only after four prior applied faults; selecting it would require a fifth fault beyond the four-fault cap. Six exact 2–4 fault sequences, including feedback-selected write ordinal 5, retained the target without a selected throw or admitted coverage gain. The scoped direct I/O candidate set is exhausted before 48 trials; uninstrumented I/O and other schedules remain outside this claim.
coverage_gain_qualification: coverage_gain is observed new line coverage against the healthy seed; admitted_coverage_gain requires exact applied faults and target evaluation after the final fault
quality_limit: The pre-target client TCP write ordinal 6 was observed only after four prior applied faults; a fifth-fault path was not tested. Uninstrumented I/O and other schedules are outside this scoped result.
